name: Hawaii
agency: Med-QUEST Division, Hawaii Department of Human Services

period.description: Spend-down is checked month by month; you are enrolled once your medical costs for the month reach your spend-down amount.

submission.description: Give proof of your medical costs to your Med-QUEST eligibility office. How bills are sent and counted was not confirmed; ask your eligibility worker.

notes: There is no top income limit for people who are 65+, blind or disabled to use spend-down.
If you need spend-down only for past months, you get care paid fee-for-service instead of joining a health plan.
If your spend-down is large, Hawaii may set an enrollment fee equal to it. Ask Med-QUEST how this works for you.
